## Summary

What changed, and why?

## Related issue or discussion

Link the public issue or discussion when applicable.

## Verification

List the commands run and the results. For a bug fix, explain how the regression
test demonstrates the fix.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/cogniumhq/skillsregistry/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept this PR focused.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] I added a changeset if this PR touches `packages/*` (CI requires one).
- [ ] I removed credentials, personal data, and private skill content from the diff.
